subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` wait and cache-replay an accepted disconnected Gateway run before its automatic isolated embedded fallback, or retain immediate fallback as the default interaction?
rationale: The choice changes a user-visible CLI compatibility contract: result latency, whether users receive the authoritative original result, and whether an ambiguous disconnect may intentionally start another run. The linked canonical issue remains open for that policy decision.

options.title: Approve recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Adopt wait-and-cache-replay as the default after an accepted disconnect, retain the isolated embedded fallback only after recovery is exhausted, and require final-head fault proof.

options.title: Keep immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Retain current main behavior and substantially narrow or close this branch because prompt results outweigh recovery-first semantics.

options.title: Fail closed after ambiguity
options.body: Require an explicit user opt-in before any rerun after unrecoverable recovery, with a separately approved CLI contract.

recommendation.title: Approve recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt wait-and-cache-replay as the default after an accepted disconnect, retain the isolated embedded fallback only after recovery is exhausted, and require final-head fault proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged fresh-session fallback behavior whose successor policy is under review.
